lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: So stop me. Go on. But be specific, because I have been managed by professionals since I was twenty-two, and the way it is always done is that somebody tells me the shape of a concern and lets me fill it in myself.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Vagueness is how you get agreement without a decision. I have used it. I would rather you didn't.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In 2091 you upload. You move into a chassis, and then into another one, and the instrument that defines a vacancy on your board defines it by death, and does not define death.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In 2312 you are still in the fourth chair. Four billion people have their housing, their work and their medicine decided under something you sign this Thursday, and not one of them can find your name, because the name on the budget line is a holding company with no address.

choices.text: Come with us. See it. Then decide what you sign.
There is nothing to discuss. You are the problem.
